message.content:
For a reflection through a plane with unit normal vector \(\mathbf n\), the reflection matrix is
\[
R=I-2\mathbf n\mathbf n^T.
\]
So
\[
I-R=2\mathbf n\mathbf n^T.
\]

Compute:
\[
I-R=
\begin{pmatrix}
\frac{4}{15} & -\frac{2}{15} & -\frac{10}{15}\\
-\frac{2}{15} & \frac{1}{15} & \frac{5}{15}\\
-\frac{10}{15} & \frac{5}{15} & \frac{25}{15}
\end{pmatrix}
=
\frac1{15}
\begin{pmatrix}
4&-2&-10\\
-2&1&5\\
-10&5&25
\end{pmatrix}.
\]
Now observe that
\[
\begin{pmatrix}
4&-2&-10\\
-2&1&5\\
-10&5&25
\end{pmatrix}
=
\begin{pmatrix}2\\-1\\-5\end{pmatrix}
\begin{pmatrix}2&-1&-5\end{pmatrix}.
\]
Thus the normal vector is proportional to
\[
\begin{pmatrix}2\\-1\\-5\end{pmatrix}.
\]
Since \(a>0\) and the gcd is \(1\), the required normal vector is
\[
\boxed{\begin{pmatrix}2\\-1\\-5\end{pmatrix}}.
\]

The answer is \(\begin{pmatrix}2\\-1\\-5\end{pmatrix}\).
